Before you purchase

Course purchase terms

Sold by Ascore Creative FZC LLC. Questions and order support: info@ascore.ae.

Each course costs AED 2.00; both courses cost AED 4.00. Ascore Creative is not VAT registered and adds no VAT. There is no recurring subscription. Advertising spend and third-party tool subscriptions are separate.

You receive the selected English PDF guide after Nomod confirms payment. Private download links are sent to your checkout email. Check your inbox and spam folder; contact Ascore if the email does not arrive. Links expire after 24 hours and permit 10 downloads per course. Keep the downloaded PDF for lifetime access; contact Ascore with your order reference if you need a fresh link.

The Meta Ads course includes a 30-day money-back guarantee: email info@ascore.ae within 30 days of payment to request a refund. Refund requests are handled by Ascore. No refund is initiated automatically.

These are independent educational guides, with no promise of certification, sales or advertising results. Meta Ads includes ongoing Google Meet support every Friday at 2 PM UAE time. Joining details are emailed on Friday morning. For enquiries, WhatsApp or call +971568555626. Personal learning use only; please do not redistribute the paid PDFs.

Measurement is optional. The privacy control lets you allow or decline Google Analytics and Meta Pixel; your choice does not affect purchasing. Payment details are entered on Nomod’s hosted payment page.
